what: Where story campaign objectives happen, placed by hand on the map.
holds: The story campaign is published without a single coordinate anywhere. Every position here was placed in the map editor and checked in game.
caveats: IDS AND COORDINATES ONLY. The chapter names and objective descriptions belong to the project that publishes the campaign, so they are not republished here under a licence that is not theirs to give. Join on objectiveId for the wording.
A group holding one point is a marker; a group holding several is an area, and the points are its outline.
`floor` is the storey chosen at placement, not derived from a height.
